meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你的 Mac 菜单栏加一个闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止;点击可启动、停止、重启服务,还能直接打开日志。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器,或提到“状态栏”“菜单栏图标”等时触发;若已安装,它直接跳到验证步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 菜单栏会出现闪电图标,显示运行状态

say.text: 检查 NanoClaw 的状态栏是否已装好
say.note: 已安装就直接验证,不重复安装

say.text: 把 NanoClaw 的状态栏图标加上去,用红绿点显示状态
say.note: 会编译安装,并提供启动/停止/重启

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will add a lightning-bolt icon to your macOS menu bar. A green dot means NanoClaw is running; a red dot means stopped. Click it to start, stop, restart, or view logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw on macOS, or mention 'status bar' / 'menu bar icon'. If already installed, it skips to verification.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: A bolt icon appears in the menu bar showing status.

say_en.text: Check if NanoClaw's status bar is already installed
say_en.note: If installed, it verifies without reinstalling.

say_en.text: Add the status bar icon for NanoClaw, using a green/red dot for status
